name: Heavy Squid 49
author: Dashrath-Sharma
description: Dark sky-blue button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #14213d to #fca311, width becomes 100%, height becomes 100%.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Heavy Squid 49</title>
<style>
/* Heavy Squid 49 by Dashrath-Sharma — https://uiverse.io/Dashrath-Sharma/heavy-squid-49 */
button {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font-size: 17px;
  padding: 1em 2em;
  position: relative;
  color: #14213d;
  background: #f1f1f1;
  display: grid;
  font-weight: 700;
  place-items: center;
  transition: color 350ms linear 650ms;
  border-top-right-radius: 10px;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 1;
}

button:hover {
  color: #fca311;
}

button::before,
button::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  width: 0;
  height: 6%;
}

button::before {
  background: #fca311;
  transition: width 350ms, height 350ms linear 650ms;
}

button:hover::before {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

button:after {
  background: #14213d;
  transition: width 350ms linear 175ms, height 350ms linear 650ms;
}

button:hover::after {
  width: 95%;
  height: 100%;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
